name: myai
description: MyAi: AI chat assistant with streaming replies, saved history, tone toggle, answer comparison, thinking levels and branching. React + Tailwind, Express, MongoDB, Claude or OpenAI.

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c yellow,white "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server && npm test --prefix client
